put.description:
Store the body of the request as file under the query-parameter `path`,\
which is relative to the storage-location. An existing file is overwritten and missing directories\
are created.\
\
The body is streamed directly into the file, so it can have any size. If the upload breaks off\
before the announced `Content-Length` was received, the incomplete file is deleted again.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.

parameters.description: path relative to the storage-location, an empty path is the storage-location itself

get.description:
Stream the content of the file under the query-parameter `path`, which is\
relative to the storage-location.\
\
The size of the file is sent in the header `Content-Length`, so the caller detects a download,\
which broke off. Symbolic links are not followed.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.

delete.description:
Delete the file under the query-parameter `path`, which is relative to the\
storage-location. Deleting a not existing file is no error. A symbolic link is removed itself and\
not followed.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.

get.description:
Get the size and the hex-encoded sha256-checksum of the file under the\
query-parameter `path`, which is relative to the storage-location. The whole file is read for the\
checksum, which takes its time for large files. Symbolic links are not followed.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.

get.description:
List the direct entries of the directory under the query-parameter `path`,\
which is relative to the storage-location, sorted by name. An empty path lists the\
storage-location itself. Symbolic links are listed as files with the size of the link.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.

delete.description:
Delete the directory under the query-parameter `path`, which is relative to\
the storage-location, with all of its content. Deleting a not existing directory is no error.\
Symbolic links within the directory are removed, but not followed. The storage-location itself\
can not be deleted.\
\
This is an internal call, which is protected by the internal api-key and the token of a user.
